polityNote: Regions of Belarus from the declaration of independence (25 Aug 1991) to the dissolution of the USSR; the present-day units are carried back from 26 Dec 1991 and OpenHistoricalMap’s Byelorussian SSR ends 18 Sep 1991. Atoms: geoBoundaries BLR ADM1 (CIESIN 2005, CC BY 3.0, 8,373 vertices vs. 5,761 in Natural Earth).

sources.title: Statoids — Regions of Belarus, change history
sources.says: The last changes listed between regions are the 1960 reorganisation (Molodechno divided, Begoml and Glusk transferred); in 1993 Minsk city was split from Minsk region and names were modernised.

sources.title: Wikipedia — Regions of Belarus
sources.says: Belarus is divided into six regions and the city of Minsk.
